name: d1_minimal_pairs_v1
purpose: D1 DISCRIMINATION. One question: does n_amb=0 follow the MEANING of the unknown, or the FORM of the utterance? FORM axis holds the semantic unknown fixed and varies phrasing; SEMANTIC axis holds the family fixed on held-out utterances. Controls are proven emitters (9/9). expected_terminal is nominal -- this corpus scores n_amb, not terminals.
hypotheses: MEANING: form variants of c2/c3 still emit n_amb=0, AND held-out consumption/multiplier utterances also emit n_amb=0 -> interpreter/schema compliance failure specific to those semantics.
FORM: form variants emit ambiguities while the originals do not -> a prompt/representation-shape problem, not semantics.
NEITHER separates -> look for another shared structural feature.
